data.title: [Journey of the Long-Ear] Celebration Event Details
data.brief:
You are the chosen long-ear, a new rising star idolized by many. This is your epic journey. 
▼// Eve
data.data:
You are the chosen long-ear, a new rising star idolized by many. This is your epic journey.


▼// Event Time

Apr. 1, 2026 at 12:00 – Apr. 8, 2026 at 04:00 (server time)

Asia Server Time Zone: UTC+8

Americas / Europe Server Time Zone: UTC-5


▼// Participation Requirements

After the Event Center is unlocked


▼// Event Details

· During the event, collect various [Sights] and [Souvenirs] in your journey and complete specified missions to earn generous rewards.

· After completing the missions, the rewards will be sent to your in-game Mail. Claim them in time as the reward mail expires in 30 days, Endministrator.
